title: Spectral scalar curvature and Urysohn width in dimension three
main_claim: A complete connected 3-manifold with -4Δ+Scal ≥ λ>0 (quadratic form sense) admits a continuous map to a 1-dimensional simplicial complex whose entire fibers have g-diameter ≤ 500/√λ; no orientability/compactness/bounded geometry assumed.
coverage: Read all six sections in full. I checked by hand: the ground-state weight t=-2log v and D(g,t)≥1; the second-variation sign conventions (H', ν', and the derivative of H-νT-μ); the Gauss/Laplacian decomposition and the exact curvature-transfer identity, including the cancellation of the Ric and Hess terms; the conformal Gauss curvature bound; the index-form change of variables and the completing-the-square identity, giving L≤2π/√c; the Gauss–Bonnet topology restriction to S²/RP²; the exit lemma. In Section 3: the Zorn maximal family, local finiteness via H_2(Z/2) independence, the Thom-form detection of the crossing number, antisymmetric minimization on the orientation cover, the boundary retraction (div Y = H = 0, α = ι_Y dvol closed and flow-invariant, Jacobian ≤ 1), the 10-ball exit argument that makes the detected sheets closed, the Stokes argument for a nonseparating component, and the passage from neat to closed hypersurfaces via S¹-valued maps lifted on collars with finite π₁. In Section 4: the collar formula D = D(k,t) - |k'/2|² - m'² - 2m'' (rederived), the C² even reflection of m and the Jensen/convexity limsup at the seam, the ρ-smoothing gradient bound 3/2+1/2, the cot-pressure bound 4π/(b-a) < 4π/69 < 1/4, the barrier comparisons, ¼+¾μ² ≥ ¼ giving 4π, and seam transversality by reflection. In Section 5: the region tree, the slab bound 2·93+4π < 220, and the cover diameter 440. In Section 6: the grouped partition, local finiteness, the anchor property of L_B, the null-homotopy through the universal-cover tree, the continuity of the collar formulas at s=0, ½, 1, the fiber bound 440+2(2π+2) < 500, and the λ-rescaling of the quadratic form. Not re-derived: the GMT regularity theorems cited (Simon Ch. 7; Kemper Thm 4.3 for weighted perimeter with pressure) and the BV compactness inputs. These are standard and appear to be applied within their hypotheses.
